issues.fix: 11_exterior.js l.463-466: add the same sun-facing term the nacelle uses (l.479) and lift the belly floor: return Math.max(0.40, (n[1] > 0.45 ? 0.93 : 0.5 + 0.4 * smooth(-0.9, -0.2, n[1])) * lerp(1, 0.62, smooth(0.06, 0.65, dy)) * (1 - 0.35 * smooth(0.05, 0.6, V3.dot(n, LD)))); LD has to be declared before l.463: move l.478 up. The 0.40 floor makes the keel read as a band and not an outline. Expected w26K: flank about 160 x 0.68 = 110-120 (0.6 of the skin) and top about 185-195 (0.97). The A side is unaffected, because its sun-away faces have dot(n, LD) < 0 and the l.467-471 lift still applies.

issues.problem: The near-far value is still reversed or flat in w19A: the near flap is 163 and the far skin 160-169, where KN41 falls 25 %. The l.256 roughness ramp was worth only about 4 L. The remaining lever is the grazing env term, which ignores the baked albedo ramp.
issues.fix: Lighting owner (04_shaders.js exterior branch): multiply specEnv by clamp(luma(v_col) / luma(matBase), 0.6, 1.1), so the l.252 ramp (1.12 -> 0.80) also scales the reflection. In this file: steepen l.252 to lerp(1.15, 0.72, ...) only after that shader change; on its own it would just flatten the near panels.
